thread:
Sarah (AE): HollowSun just dropped their RFP + security questionnaire. They want a 2-week POC with a capability matrix and an ask for committed pricing if POC goes well. I uploaded the packet here: https://drive.redwood/hollowsun-rfp :eyes:
Mike (SE): Quick clarifying Qs — target QPS and average prompt length for the POC? Are they testing embeddings, generation, or both? For generation, recommend Dedicated with 2 GPUs or a burst policy. Also asking if quantization is acceptable for their quality bar.
Sarah (AE): They said mixed workload, mostly chat/generation with some embeddings for search. Target ~20 qps peak, avg prompt ~120 tokens, baseline eval set attached in the packet.
Ravi (SA): If data residency is EU-only we should flag Private/VPC option. On HSM: Private supports customer-managed KMS/HSM; need to confirm HSM model with them. See our deployment note: https://docs.redwood/private-hsm.
Anya (Security): I skimmed the questionnaire. They want SOC 2, encryption at rest, VPC peering, and subprocessor list. We can provide SOC2 report and our subprocessor list, but for HSM SLA we'll need Legal sign-off. Also need sample of data flow diagrams (PII ingress/egress).
Priya (Legal): I'll need the specific sections they want redlined (esp. Section 4 on data processing). Send questionnaire pages 3–6. We do standard DPA + limited subprocessor addendum; if they demand custom KMS terms that may delay.
Mike (SE): For the POC config draft (quick copy):
```
model: redwood/open-13b-quant
deployment: dedicated
gpus: 2
batch_size: 16
kv_cache: enabled
quantization: 4bit
request_limit: 20 qps (burst 40)
logs_retention: 90d (PII redaction enabled)
```
Mike (SE): If they want higher fidelity, run 1x fp16 instance for eval and compare. I'll prepare perf numbers.
Sarah (AE): HollowSun contact is emma@hollowsun.com. Emma asked whether we can include a capability matrix export and a short demo run with ~100k tokens/day.
Anya (Security): 100k tokens/day is fine on Dedicated but we need to agree on log retention and telemetry. Recommend we propose 90 days retention and redact PII fields by default. Also confirm whether they need audit-log streaming to their SIEM (we can support via syslog/S3).
Joel (Sales Ops): Pricing note — for a 2-week POC we usually offer a discounted trial tier (dev burst). If they convert to Dedicated reserved monthly, propose 3-tier: Dev POC (discounted), Preprod (committed 1-3mo), Prod Reserved (annual commit). I'll draft numbers and attach a cost table.
Priya (Legal): Also note: if they require KMS/HSM attestation we may need additional procurement SOW. Flagging this as a potential procurement blocker.
Ravi (SA): Action items: 1) Mike to build perf/quant tradeoff doc and baseline run. 2) Priya to review questionnaire redlines. 3) Joel to create POC vs reserved pricing table. 4) Sarah to confirm data residency and intro call with Emma.
Mike (SE): I'll have the perf doc + a minimal eval script by tomorrow morning. Will include a small sample of the prompts and the command to reproduce (docker snippet).
Sarah (AE): Thanks — please ping me in the thread when docs are ready. I'll schedule a 30-min call with HollowSun for Tue morning. :thumbsup:
Joel (Sales Ops): Putting the draft cost table in the shared drive now. link: https://drive.redwood/hollowsun-pricing-draft
Anya (Security): I'll request the DPA + SOC2 package to be uploaded to the same drive and reply with redline comments.
Priya (Legal): Send me their exact questionnaire pages and any additional NDA asks, I'll start the review.
Sarah (AE): Great. If anyone hits a blocker before EOD ping me directly.
